Gmail label setup — do this before your first file

Aari Google review link

The single Aari Google review link used in every review request email. Set it once here and it fills {{google_review_link_aari}} for all TCs and the automated review sends. Leave blank to keep the manual paste-in placeholder.

Services we are accepting

Switch a service off and it disappears from the website, cannot be ordered, and stops billing. Coordinators can still create and track those files for deadlines and emails, so nothing in flight is disturbed.

Offer email

The email you send to the listing agent when you submit an offer, before any file exists. Pick the agent, the property, and the documents going out, then copy and send.
